dockerfile.amd64:
# syntax=docker/dockerfile:1

FROM ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/baseimage-alpine:3.24

ENV LSIO_FIRST_PARTY=true

# set version label
ARG BUILD_DATE
ARG VERSION
ARG SEALSKIN_VERSION
LABEL build_version="Linuxserver.io version:- ${VERSION} Build-date:- ${BUILD_DATE}"
LABEL maintainer="thelamer"
ENV HOME=/config

# install software
RUN \
  echo "**** install build packages ****" && \
  apk add --no-cache --upgrade --virtual=build-dependencies \
    python3-dev \
    py3-pip && \
  echo "**** install packages ****" && \
  apk add --no-cache \
    caddy \
    openssl \
    python3 && \
  echo "**** install sealskin ****" && \
  if [ -z ${SEALSKIN_VERSION+x} ]; then \
    SEALSKIN_VERSION=$(curl -sX GET "https://api.github.com/repos/selkies-project/sealskin/releases/latest" \
    | jq -r '.tag_name'); \
  fi && \
  curl -o \
    "/tmp/sealskin_server-${SEALSKIN_VERSION}-py3-none-any.whl" -L \
    "https://github.com/selkies-project/sealskin/releases/download/${SEALSKIN_VERSION}/sealskin_server-${SEALSKIN_VERSION}-py3-none-any.whl" && \
  pip3 install \
    "/tmp/sealskin_server-${SEALSKIN_VERSION}-py3-none-any.whl" --break-system-packages && \
  echo "**** cleanup ****" && \
  printf "Linuxserver.io version: ${VERSION}\nBuild-date: ${BUILD_DATE}" > /build_version && \
  apk del --purge \
    build-dependencies && \
  rm -rf \
    $HOME/.cache \
    /tmp/*

# add local files
COPY root/ /

# ports and volumes
EXPOSE 8000 8443
VOLUME /config /storage

units.name: init-sealskin
units.script:
#!/usr/bin/with-contenv bash
# shellcheck shell=bash

mkdir -p /config/ssl

# create self signed cert
if [ ! -f "/config/ssl/proxy_key.pem" ]; then
  openssl req -new -x509 \
    -days 3650 -nodes \
    -out /config/ssl/proxy_cert.pem \
    -keyout /config/ssl/proxy_key.pem \
    -subj "/C=US/ST=CA/L=Carlsbad/O=Linuxserver.io/OU=LSIO Server/CN=*"
  chmod 600 /config/ssl/proxy_key.pem
fi

# generate server key
if [ ! -f "/config/ssl/server_key.pem" ]; then
  openssl genpkey \
    -algorithm RSA \
    -out /config/ssl/server_key.pem \
    -pkeyopt rsa_keygen_bits:4096
  chmod 600 /config/ssl/server_key.pem
fi

# docker socket perms
DOCKER_SOCK_PATH="/var/run/docker.sock"
if [ -S "${DOCKER_SOCK_PATH}" ]; then
  DOCKER_GID=$(stat -c '%g' "${DOCKER_SOCK_PATH}")
  if ! id -G abc | grep -qw "${DOCKER_GID}"; then
    DOCKER_GROUP_NAME=$(getent group "${DOCKER_GID}" | awk -F: '{print $1}')
    if [ -z "${DOCKER_GROUP_NAME}" ]; then
      DOCKER_GROUP_NAME="docker_sock_group"
      echo "**** Creating group '${DOCKER_GROUP_NAME}' with GID ${DOCKER_GID} for the Docker socket ****"
      groupadd -g "${DOCKER_GID}" "${DOCKER_GROUP_NAME}"
    fi
    echo "**** Adding user 'abc' to group '${DOCKER_GROUP_NAME}' (GID: ${DOCKER_GID}) ****"
    usermod -a -G "${DOCKER_GROUP_NAME}" abc
  fi
  if [ "$(stat -c '%A' "${DOCKER_SOCK_PATH}" | cut -c 5,6)" != "rw" ]; then
    echo -e "\n**** WARNING: The Docker socket ${DOCKER_SOCK_PATH} does not have group read/write permissions. ****"
    echo "**** To fix this, run the following command on your DOCKER HOST: ****"
    echo -e "sudo chmod g+rw ${DOCKER_SOCK_PATH}\n"
  fi
fi

# perms
lsiown abc:abc /storage
lsiown -R abc:abc /config

units.name: svc-sealskin
units.script:
#!/usr/bin/with-contenv bash
# shellcheck shell=bash

# Run SealSkin
exec s6-setuidgid abc \
  sealskin-server

notes.upstream:
# SealSkin 0.5.2

Maintenance release.

## Collaboration

* **Collaboration profiles.** An administrator assigns a profile to users
  and groups under **Collaboration profile**, and it decides what their
  collaboration rooms may do. Chat, cameras, microphones, the application
  switcher, mouse and keyboard handoff, gamepads, collaborator invites, and
  viewer invites can each be turned off, and collaborators can be kept from
  sharing viewer invites. A profile can also keep the stream at the
  controller's resolution and cap how many people may join a room. The
  server refuses whatever a profile turns off, whatever a guest's page
  sends. Where a user's groups name several profiles, each feature takes the
  most restrictive. A room keeps the rules it started under. The form
  previews the room's bar as the controller, a collaborator, and a viewer see
  it. Profiles are kept in the shared record `collaboration_profiles.yml`
  (`SEALSKIN_COLLABORATION_PROFILES_PATH`). A user under no profile gets
  every feature, as before.
* **People in a room.** The room's bar has a people button that lists
  everyone in the room, viewers included, with whether their microphone and
  camera are on and what input they hold. The controller can hand a
  collaborator the mouse and keyboard from it. Bugfix: A participant whose 
  camera is off keeps a tile.

## Fixes

* With `SEALSKIN_AUTO_SIGN_IN=oidc`, an application's address such as
  `/app/<app_id>/` is now kept through the identity provider's round trip,
  so the user lands on that application after signing in rather than on the
  home page.

reasons: 1 commit (3e8e0cd → 3e23a69): the pipeline's own package table update
